welcome.title: 👋 Murakaza neza, Munyeshuri!
welcome.content: Murakaza neza kuri Bootskills Student Portal! 🎉 Uru rugendo rw'ihuse ruzakwereka uko ukora utangira kwiga, gukora code, no kubaka umwuga wawe wizewe.

sidebar.title: 📋 Kugenda ku rubande
sidebar.content: Uyu ni **urubande rwawe rwo kugendamo**. Ukoresha urugenda mu nzego zose z'irembo ryawe — ikibaho, amasomo, imishinga, kwishyura, n'ibindi.

dashboard.title: 📊 Ikibaho
dashboard.content: **Ikibaho cyawe** kiguha incamake ya byose: XP, urutonde rwawe, urwego, amasomo wanditsemo, ibikorwa biheruka, n'ibigomba kurangira.

projects.title: 💼 Imishinga
projects.content: Rebe kandi usabe **Imushinga nyayo** itanzwe n'abakiriya. Wubake portfolio yawe ugiye kubona uburambe.

courses.title: 📚 Amasomo Yange
courses.content: Icyiciro cya **Amasomo** — togera amasomo wanditsemo, ukomeze amasomo, ukurikire iterambere, ukore ibihembwe byose ahantu hamwe.

internship.title: 🏢 Imyitozo
internship.content: Umariza amasomo yawe, saba **Imyitozo** hano. Uzabona uburambe nyabwo bw'akazi mu nzego zawe.

schedule.title: 📅 Gahunda
schedule.content: **Gahunda yawe** — reba amasomo azaza, guhamagara abatoza, ibigomba kurangira, n'amasomo ku mbonera mu karemano kamwe.

billing.title: 💳 Kwishyuza n'Amafaranga
billing.content: Icyiciro cya **Kwishyuza** niho ugobora amafaranga. Iyandikishe mu masomo yishyurwa, ube amakusanyirizo, ukurikire amateka yo kwishyura. Ushobora kwishyura ukoresheje mobile money cyangwa karta.

certificates.title: 🎓 Impamyashahembo
certificates.content: Umariza amasomo yawe yose, **Impamyashahembo** yawe izagaragara hano. Manura kandi usangize ahantu hose.

header.title: 🔝 Umurongo wo hejuru
header.content: **Umurongo wo hejuru** uguha uburyo bwihuse bwo gushaka, XP/urutonde/urwego (ku banyeshuri), amatangazo, impinduka y'ibara, na porofile yawe.

notifications.title: 🔔 Amatangazo
notifications.content: Komeza kumenya! **Inzogera y'amatangazo** irabura iyo ubonye ubutumwa, ibitekerezo ku bihembwe, cyangwa ibintu by'ingenzi bishya.

userMenu.title: 👤 Porofile yawe
userMenu.content: Kanda kuri **Avatar** yawe kugirango ugere kuri genamiterere, usubire ku rubuga, cyangwa usohoke. Ushobora no gutangiza uru rugendo uwo ari wo wese mumenya.

ready.title: 🎉 Uteguriye! 🚀
ready.content: **Uteguriye!** 🚀 Tangira ukoresheje Ikibaho cyawe, iyandikishe mu masomo, utangire urugendo rwo kwiga. Ukeneye ubufasha? Kanda ku nzogera cyangwa sura paji y'ubufasha.

welcome.title: 👋 Murakaza neza, Mwarimu!
welcome.content: Murakaza neza kuri Bootskills Trainer Portal! 🎓 Uru rugendo ruzakuyobora mu gukora abanyeshuri, amasomo, ibihembwe, n'ibikorwa byawe by'umwuga.

sidebar.title: 📋 Kugenda ku rubande
sidebar.content: **Urubande rwawe rwo kugendamo** ni icyicaro cyawe cy'ubuyobozi. Uhindura hagati y'amasomo, abanyeshuri, ubuyobozi, gahunda, n'ibindi.

dashboard.title: 📊 Ikibaho
dashboard.content: **Ikibaho** kiguha incamake y'abanyeshuri bawe, ibisubirwamo bitegereje, amasomo akora, n'ibikorwa biheruka.

courses.title: 📚 Amasomo Yange
courses.content: Genzura **Amasomo yawe** — kora amasomo mashya, ukurikire iterambere ry'abanyeshuri, uvugurure ibirimo, ukurikire igipimo cy'urangiza.

students.title: 👥 Abanyeshuri
students.content: Reba **Abanyeshuri bawe** — reba abiyandikishije, ukurikire iterambere ryabo, amanota, ubasabe ubufasha.

mentorship.title: 🤝 Ubuyobozi
mentorship.content: Icyiciro cya **Ubuyobozi** — gahunda za sessiyo ku giti cyawe, ukurikire amasaha y'ubuyobozi, ugobore abo uyobora.

internships.title: 🏢 Imyitozo
internships.content: Genzura **Imyitozo** — reba iterambere ry'abanyeshuri b'imyitozo, shyiramo inshingano, utange ibitekerezo ku mishyingo nyayo.

schedule.title: 📅 Gahunda
schedule.content: **Gahunda yawe** — genzura amahirwe yawe, reba sessiyo zizaza, ugene igihe cyo kwigisha.

header.title: 🔝 Umurongo wo hejuru
header.content: **Umurongo wo hejuru** werekana umubare w'abanyeshuri, amasomo akora, ibisubirwamo bitegereje, kandi uguha uburyo bwihuse bwo kugera ku matangazo na porofile yawe.

userMenu.title: 👤 Porofile yawe
userMenu.content: **Porofile yawe** — ubeza genamiterere, usubire ku rubuga, cyangwa usohoke. Ushobora gutangiza uru rugendo uwo ari wo wese.

ready.title: 🎉 Uteguriye!
ready.content: **Uteguriye!** 🚀 Tangira ukoresheje ikibaho cyawe, ukurikire abanyeshuri, ukore amasomo yawe. Ukeneye ubufasha? Inzogera irahari. Ushobora gutangiza uru rugendo uwo ari wo wese.

welcome.title: 👋 Murakaza neza, Muyobozi!
welcome.content: Murakaza neza kuri Bootskills Admin Dashboard! 🛠️ Uru rugendo ruzakuyobora mu gukora abakoresha, amasomo, amafaranga, imishinga, n'ibikorwa bya porogaramu.

sidebar.title: 📋 Kugenda ku rubande
sidebar.content: **Urubande rwawe** ni icyicaro cy'ubuyobozi. Koresha Gucunga, Imishinga, Ibigize, Ibikorwa, n'ibindi.

dashboard.title: 📊 Ikibaho
dashboard.content: **Ikibaho** kiguha ibipimo by'ingenzi — umubare w'abakoresha, abanyeshuri, amasomo, amafaranga yinjira, n'ibikorwa bya porogaramu.

users.title: 👥 Abakoresha
users.content: Genzura **Abakoresha bose** — reba, hindura, shyiramo inshingano, ukurikire ibikorwa, ugobore konti z'abanyeshuri/abatoza ahantu hamwe.

courses.title: 📚 Amasomo
courses.content: Ucunga **Amasomo** — kora, hindura, shyira ahagaragara, ugene amasomo. Shyiramo abatoza, shyiraho ibiciro, ugobore module.

payments.title: 💳 Kwishyura na Kwishyuza
payments.content: Icyiciro cya **Kwishyura** — reba ibikorwa byose, ukurikire amafaranga yinjira, ugobore gusubiza amafaranga, ugenzure ukwishyura.

internships.title: 🏢 Imyitozo
internships.content: Genzura **Gahunda z'Imyitozo** — kora gahunda, ukurikire iterambere ry'abanyeshuri b'imyitozo, ugobore gushyirwa.

analytics.title: 📈 Isesengura
analytics.content: **Isesengura** — jinjira mu bipimo bya porogaramu, imikorere y'abanyeshuri, igipimo cy'urangiza amasomo, n'uburyo amafaranga yinjira.

header.title: 🔝 Umurongo wo hejuru
header.content: **Umurongo wo hejuru** werekana ibipimo by'ingenzi — abakoresha bose, abanyeshuri, n'amasomo. Ubona amatangazo, guhindura ibara, na porofile yawe.

userMenu.title: 👤 Porofile yawe
userMenu.content: **Porofile yawe** — ubeza genamiterere, usubire ku rubuga, cyangwa usohoke. Ushobora gutangiza uru rugendo uwo ari wo wese.

ready.title: 🎉 Uteguriye!
ready.content: **Uteguriye!** 🚀 Tangira ucunga porogaramu yawe ukoresheje Ikibaho. Urubande rufite ibyo ukeneye byose. Subiramo uru rugendo uwo ari wo wese kuri porofile yawe.

welcome.title: 👋 Murakaza neza, Super Admin!
welcome.content: Murakaza neza kuri Bootskills Super Admin Panel! 🔐 Uru rugendo rugizweho ruzibanda ku gahunda ya sisitemu, gukora abakoresha, ibikorwa by'amafaranga, n'ibindi.

sidebar.title: 📋 Kugenda ku rubande
sidebar.content: **Urubande rwawe** rufite byose — Gucunga sisitemu, Marketing, Isesengura, Ikarte y'abakoresha, n'ibindi. Buri gice gifite amateka arambuye.

dashboard.title: 📊 Ikibaho
dashboard.content: **Ikibaho** kiguha ishusho nini — abakoresha bose, abanyeshuri, abatoza, amafaranga yinjira, n'ubuzima bwa porogaramu.

users.title: 👥 Abakoresha BOSE
users.content: **Abakoresha bose** — ugenga konti zose. Tobanya, shaka, hindura inshingano, ucunge urutonde rwose rw'abakoresha.

config.title: ⚙️ Igenamiterere
config.content: **Igenamiterere** — shyiraho imitwarire rusange ya porogaramu, ibiciro, ibiranga, n'amahitamo rusange.

commissions.title: 💰 Komisiyo
commissions.content: **Igenamiterere rya komisiyo** — shyiraho igipimo cya komisiyo ku batoza, bonus yo kureferra, n'uburyo bwo kwishyura.

disbursements.title: 💸 Kwishyura
disbursements.content: **Kwishyura** — ugobore kwishyura abatoza n'abafatanyabikorwa. Reba amateka yo kwishyura utangire kohereza.

discountCodes.title: 🏷️ Kode z'igabanyirizo
discountCodes.content: **Kode z'igabanyirizo** — kora ugobore kode z'igabanyirizo, ukurikire isesengura ry'imikoreshereze, ushyireho ingamba z'igabanyirizo.

refunds.title: 🔄 Gusubiza amafaranga
refunds.content: **Gusubiza amafaranga** — ukore ubusabe bwo gusubiza amafaranga ku banyeshuri, ube amakimbirane, ukore uruziga rwo gusubiza.

header.title: 🔝 Umurongo wo hejuru
header.content: **Umurongo wo hejuru** werekana ibipimo by'igihe — abakoresha bose, abanyeshuri, n'abatoza. Ugenzura amatangazo na porofile yawe byihuse.

userMenu.title: 👤 Porofile yawe
userMenu.content: **Porofile yawe** — genamiterere, usubire ku rubuga, cyangwa usohoke. Subiramo uru rugendo uwo ari wo wese.

ready.title: 🎉 Uteguriye!
ready.content: **Uteguriye!** 🚀 Ubu uzi ibice by'ingenzi bya porogaramu ya Super Admin. Tangira ukoresheje Ikibaho ukore buri gice. Subiramo uru rugendo uwo ari wo wese kuri porofile yawe.

student.overview: Irembo ry'Umuntu wiga niwe ugerwaho amasomo, ukurikira iterambere, ugobora amafaranga, usaba imyitozo, ukabona impamyashahembo. Byose ukeneye kuva ku utangira kugeza uba umwuga witeguye.

trainer.overview: Irembo ry'Umwarimu rikugira byose ukeneye kugirango ugobore amasomo, uyobore abanyeshuri, uhaware ibihembwe, ukurikire ibikorwa byawe by'umwuga. Murakaza neza mu itsinda ry'uburezi!

admin.overview: Ikibaho ry'Ubuyobozi niwe ugerwaho ugobora porogaramu. Hano ugenga abakoresha, amasomo, amafaranga, imishinga, imyitozo, n'isesengura. Byose binyura hano.

superAdmin.overview: Porogaramu ya Super Admin iguha ubushobozi bwuzuye ku porogaramu yose. Igenamiterere rya sisitemu, ibikorwa by'amafaranga, gukora abakoresha, ibikoresho bya marketing, n'isesengura rirambuye byose biri mu ntoki zawe.
